guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 本課以「用酸性氣體質量、化學當量與液氣接觸評估洗滌流程」為主軸，依序處理酸性氣體負荷與成分、循環液與氣體接觸、循環泵與輸送能量、排污水鹽分負荷、量測校正與反應證據。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
guides.conceptEn: This course focuses on Assess acid-gas scrubbing through mass load, chemical equivalents and gas-liquid contact, progressing through Acid-gas loading and species, Recirculating-liquid contact, Recirculation-pump energy, Blowdown salt load, Calibration and reaction evidence. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
procedure: 只將 Q 改成 12000 Nm³/h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.2 變成 0.24 kg/h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 R 改成 1.25，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 110 變成 125 mol/h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 G 改成 7500 m³/h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2 變成 1.6 L/m³。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 p1 改成 2200 Pa，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1200 變成 1600 Pa。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 H 改成 20 m，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.26385 變成 3.01846 kW。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 Cout 改成 20 mg/m³，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 88 變成 80 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 Q 改成 150 m³/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 30 變成 37.5 kg/d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 m 改成 130 kg/h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 62.6944 變成 81.5028 kW。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 C 改成 100，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 6 變成 10 concentration units。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 Qin 改成 40 m³/h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 40 變成 80 m³。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
procedureEn: Change only Q to 12000 Nm³/h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.2 to 0.24 kg/h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only R to 1.25, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 110 to 125 mol/h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only G to 7500 m³/h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2 to 1.6 L/m³. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only p1 to 2200 Pa, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 1200 to 1600 Pa. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only H to 20 m, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2.26385 to 3.01846 kW. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only Cout to 20 mg/m³, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 88 to 80 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only Q to 150 m³/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 30 to 37.5 kg/d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only m to 130 kg/h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 62.6944 to 81.5028 kW. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only reference C to 100, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 6 to 10 concentration units. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only Qin to 40 m³/h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 40 to 80 m³. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
evidence: 針對「酸性氣體負荷與成分」，查驗溫壓、含濕率及濃度報表欄位，再核對煙道流速與面積。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「中和反應當量」，用進出口物種分析追蹤反應與未反應藥劑，分別報去除量和逸出量。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「循環液與氣體接觸」，核對液體分布、噴嘴、循環濃度與壓降，不只檢查泵流量。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「洗滌塔壓降與阻塞」，檢查導壓管、零點和測點位置，再把差壓與流量趨勢一起畫出。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「循環泵與輸送能量」，同時讀取液位、流量、壓力和電力，核對實際工作點。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「排放濃度與去除率」，同步採入口與出口並校正相同基準，另核對出口量測不確定度。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「排污水鹽分負荷」，對齊流量計與採樣時間，以分時段 Q×C 加總，核對總量與單位。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「水分蒸發與補水」，做乾物質與水分收支，核對排氣含濕量及冷凝水。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「量測校正與反應證據」，用空白及至少兩個非零參考點檢查殘差，保留獨立查核樣。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「異常負荷與暫存能力」，比較液位曲線導出的儲量與泵流量積分，測試假想停泵事件的容量餘裕。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
evidenceEn: For Acid-gas loading and species, Check temperature, pressure, moisture and concentration-report bases, then verify duct velocity and area. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Neutralization equivalents, Track reactants and unreacted reagent at inlet and outlet; report removal and slip separately. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Recirculating-liquid contact, Check liquid distribution, nozzles, recirculating concentration and pressure drop, not pump flow alone. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Scrubber pressure drop and obstruction, Inspect impulse lines, zero and tap locations, then plot pressure drop with flow. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Recirculation-pump energy, Read levels, flow, pressure and power together to verify the actual operating point. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Emission concentration and removal, Sample inlet and outlet simultaneously on the same basis and assess outlet measurement uncertainty. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Blowdown salt load, Align flow-meter and sampling timestamps; sum interval Q×C and check totals and units. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Evaporation and makeup water, Close dry-solids and water balances, checking exhaust humidity and condensate. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Calibration and reaction evidence, Use blanks and at least two nonzero references to inspect residuals, retaining an independent check standard. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Upset loading and holding capacity, Compare level-derived storage with integrated pump flows and test capacity margin under a hypothetical pump outage. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
pitfalls: 標準氣量和實際體積流量混乘會系統性偏差。 在「酸性氣體負荷與成分」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
過量投加可能增加藥劑逸出或殘渣，而非繼續改善去除。 在「中和反應當量」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
液體旁流造成乾區，名目液氣比正常也可能去除不良。 在「循環液與氣體接觸」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
導壓管堵塞可能被誤判為設備阻塞。 在「洗滌塔壓降與阻塞」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
管道堵塞會提高阻力，固定額定功率不代表固定流量。 在「循環泵與輸送能量」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
不同基準直接相減或用低於檢出限數值當零，會誇大效率。 在「排放濃度與去除率」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
只比較濃度會把稀釋當成污染質量已移除。 在「排污水鹽分負荷」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
把材料減重全當作有機物破壞，會混淆乾燥與反應。 在「水分蒸發與補水」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
只修正零點會留下隨濃度增加的斜率偏差。 在「量測校正與反應證據」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
只用日平均流量會忽略短時暴雨造成的積存。 在「異常負荷與暫存能力」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
pitfallsEn: Multiplying standard concentration by actual volume flow creates systematic bias. Mark where this error can enter the Acid-gas loading and species flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Excess feed can increase reagent slip or residue instead of improving removal. Mark where this error can enter the Neutralization equivalents flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Liquid channeling creates dry zones even at a normal nominal liquid-to-gas ratio. Mark where this error can enter the Recirculating-liquid contact flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
A blocked impulse line can be mistaken for equipment blockage. Mark where this error can enter the Scrubber pressure drop and obstruction flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Pipe blockage raises resistance; a fixed motor rating does not imply fixed flow. Mark where this error can enter the Recirculation-pump energy flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Subtracting different bases or treating nondetects as zero exaggerates efficiency. Mark where this error can enter the Emission concentration and removal flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
A concentration-only comparison can mistake dilution for pollutant removal. Mark where this error can enter the Blowdown salt load flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Treating all weight loss as organic destruction confuses drying with reaction. Mark where this error can enter the Evaporation and makeup water flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Correcting offset alone leaves concentration-dependent slope error. Mark where this error can enter the Calibration and reaction evidence flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Daily mean flow misses storage needed during short storm peaks. Mark where this error can enter the Upset loading and holding capacity flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

courses.summary: 這項技術的學習脈絡由單一設備處理，逐步擴展至物質與能量收支、監測品質和生命週期比較。本課將官方方法文件作為查核入口，並以獨立編寫的假想數據練習；參考文件的年代與地區不代表其規範在所有場址適用。
courses.summaryEn: The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison. Official method documents provide verification starting points while independently authored hypothetical data support practice; a document date or jurisdiction does not establish applicability to every site.
